shortDefinition: An open standard for connecting AI models to external tools, databases, and services.
fullDefinition: The Model Context Protocol is an open standard introduced by Anthropic in 2024 that provides a universal interface for AI models to connect to external tools and data sources. It standardizes how AI models interact with file systems, databases, APIs, and services — creating a 'USB standard for AI integrations'. MCP servers expose capabilities that AI models can discover and use.
